notes.title: Duck Effects Update (v1.3.0)
notes.notes: [p]Hello, duck lovers![/p][p][/p][p]Previously, only two ducks could do anything in the pool: the Witcher Duck and the Dragon Duck. But now EVERY duck can bring a little fun to this tranquil pool. Some ducks are harmless, some do something weird, and some can even get a bonus in RPG mode, but all of them are now even more restless than before.[/p][p][/p][p]And remember: always keep an eye on your plastic duck.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42863846/a893cde354b3e8672116e382e529cdb0a2810903.gif"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Sandbox Mode Update! (v1.2.0)
Twitch user management update (v1.1.16)
notes.notes:
Now you can block bots or any other Twitch users so that they cannot appear in your pool.

To do this, you need to go to the game folder and create a blocked.txt file there, in which you need to list the nicknames of all the users you want to block. Each nickname must be on a separate line.

This file must be created and filled in BEFORE starting the game. If you change it while playing, you will need to restart the game.

Example contents of the blocked.txt file:

nightbot
streamelements
streamlabs
8hvdes
00_katie_is_desperate
vlmercy

notes.notes: Fixed a game crash when closing the duck info popup

notes.title: Winter update
notes.notes:
Winter has come and even in the world of ducks it started to snow. Luckily, it's still warm enough that the water doesn't freeze and the ducks can continue to frolic in the pool, watching [i]the circles on the water[/i].

Someone hung around [i]the lights[/i] that add comfort at night, the ducks are delighted! And [i]the snowman[/i] in the corner is quietly watching what is happening. Why doesn't he melt?

And, of course, [i]gifts[/i] were carefully laid out near the pool. To clean up before Christmas, the pool [i]had to be cleared of all the ducks[/i].

True, some ducks look a little strange, what happened to them? Watched too much [i]TV[/i]?

Winter in the duck world will last from December 20 to January 10, don't miss it!

notes.title: October Update is now live!
notes.notes:
Greetings to all little ducks!

This update is quite large, so you will have to clear your pool of all the ducks in order to add new amazing features.

[h2]Halloween[/h2]
In Duck World, Halloween runs from October 25 to November 5, so you'll have time to play with the [b]pumpkins[/b]. They have one [i]very special[/i] ability.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42863846/05d04ba08cb199ed50d57b246cd63f8e7d1642b7.gif[/img]

[h2]Duck Customization[/h2]
Next to the pool, you can find a new item - an easel.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42863846/ab3dd57cc36ce2f9b528d89772d8eeb4369416e5.png[/img]
This will give you the ability to customize your ducks. Almost every new duck can give you new custom items to create your own unique duck.
When you're done with your customization, simply select the duck you want to change and click the new "transform" button to apply the changes.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42863846/743b3b0f22f2b7b6e05e943703f168c0128d9917.png[/img]
[b]Attention![/b] When changing a duck, it will only change its appearance and will not gain any additional abilities.

[h2]Zooming[/h2]
Now you can zoom the entire area to see your ducks closer than before! Just scroll with the mouse wheel.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42863846/062ddc1ed029fdb53a27a3bb7224d79128c79b48.gif[/img]

[h2]Autosave[/h2]
You should not lose all game progress if the game crashes, as you could before.
